answer: Every claim climbs the prism of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the grove re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, diluted when peers disagree, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. What survives to the meadow is a record of labour, not a list of addresses.
